description: The businesses this merchant BUYS stock from — the same list as Purchasing → Suppliers. Answers 'who do I order from', 'what is my supplier’s email', 'which suppliers have open orders'. ALSO THE WAY TO TURN A SUPPLIER NAME INTO AN ID: every purchase-order and item-linking tool takes a supplier id and never a name. Each row carries openPoCount — purchase orders not yet fully received — and itemCount, how many catalogue items that supplier is linked to. This is the buying side. For what the merchant SELLS and at what price, use get_products.

search.description: Match supplier name, contact name or email
